title: Sunnah Sports
paragraphs: Bilal menghabiskan sebagian besar minggunya duduk di meja kerja, dan ia ingin tetap aktif di luar pekerjaan. Ia ingat pernah membaca bahwa berenang dan memanah sama-sama disebut sebagai Sunnah, jadi ia memutuskan untuk mencoba memanah terlebih dahulu. Setiap Minggu pagi, ia pergi ke lapangan panahan bersama dua rekan kerjanya. Mereka berlatih bersama dengan sabar, bergantian memanah, dan selalu saling menyemangati setelah setiap kali mencoba.

Bilal merasa lebih kuat, lebih tenang, dan benar-benar lebih fokus setelah setiap sesi latihan berakhir. Memiliki tubuh yang sehat dan aktif di luar pekerjaan mejanya, ia sadari, membantunya lebih berkonsentrasi selama sisa minggu kerjanya. Setelah beberapa bulan, Bilal menyadari bahwa sesi memanah akhir pekannya telah menjadi bagian rutinitas yang paling ia nantikan, kebiasaan yang menjaga tubuh dan pikirannya dalam kondisi jauh lebih baik.
answerKey: Bilal spends most of his week sitting at a desk, and he wants to stay active outside of work. He remembers reading that swimming and archery are both mentioned as Sunnah, so he decides to try archery first. Every Sunday morning, he goes to the archery field with two colleagues from his office. They practice together patiently, take turns shooting arrows, and always encourage each other after every single attempt. Bilal feels stronger, calmer, and genuinely more focused after each practice session ends. Having a healthy, active body outside of his desk job, he realizes, helps him concentrate better during the rest of his working week. After several months, Bilal notices that his weekend archery sessions have become the part of his routine he looks forward to most, a habit that keeps both his body and his mind in far better shape.
